Four sleek black upholstered bar stools with slender matte black legs line the island's near side. A monumental slab of white marble with subtle grey veining serves as both the backsplash and the range hood surround, continuing floor-to-ceiling in one uninterrupted plane. A professional stainless steel range with black knobs anchors the cooking wall. A large-scale abstract painting in warm tones of cream, charcoal, and deep rose hangs on the left wall above a low shelf, and sunlight streams in from an unseen window, casting a warm patch of light across the pale wood floor. The mood is calm and domestic with quiet sophistication. Two warm glowing sources hang above the island, casting pools of amber light across the marble surface.
